title: mammillaria prolifera subsp. haitiensis
intro: Mammillaria prolifera subsp. haitiensis, commonly known as the Haitian pincushion cactus, is a species of cactus that belongs to the Mammillaria genus and is native to Haiti. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and fever, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mammillaria prolifera subsp. haitiensis include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
